entry.title: dotnet/maui - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-07-16
entry.content:
Issues

  • Add a method to CollectionView to scroll to the top of a group header #30668

    .NET 10 Planning

  • GraphicsView event handlers are triggered even when IsEnabled is set to False #30649
